kpis.label: Active Projects
kpis.detail: KPI=10. Link uses lowercase 'active'. Backend /projects ignores the status param entirely (returns all 40: 10 ACTIVE / 20 CLOSED / 10 COMPLETED, totalCount=40). ProjectsPage (dsRefresh ON, confirmed forced in docker-compose.v2-staging.yml + deployed chunk DeliveryManagerDashboardPage-CEIX43ZM.js links to lowercase 'active') applies a CASE-SENSITIVE client filter `item.status !== filters.status` -> 'ACTIVE' !== 'active' is true for every row -> ALL 10 active projects filtered out -> landing list shows 0 rows. KPI says 10, drilldown shows 0.

kpis.label: Active Positions
kpis.detail: KPI=95 (DM portfolio-scoped). Drilldown /staffing-desk?status=active is GLOBAL/un-scoped: returns totalCount=436 position rows (status param IS honored: no-filter=645 -> active=436), with its own kpis.activeAssignments=93. Neither 436 (list count) nor 93 (staffing-desk KPI) equals the dashboard's 95. The DM KPI counts active position-assignment views on the DM's active projects; the drilldown shows org-wide positions. No path lands the user on a 95-row list.

kpis.label: Unstaffed
kpis.drilldownLink: #unstaffed-projects (in-page tab switch to Portfolio tab; NOT a cross-page list)
kpis.drilldownEndpoint: in-page: portfolioHealth rows with staffingCount===0 + staffingGaps[]
kpis.detail: KPI=0. Portfolio tab shows portfolioHealth rows with staffingCount===0 (count=0) and staffingGaps (length=0). 0=0. Note: Unstaffed is not a true cross-page drilldown (just a tab pivot), and the 'Staffing Gaps' section it lands on actually lists positions-ending-soon, NOT no-staff projects, so the conceptual target differs — but with value 0 there is no count mismatch to flag.

supportingEndpoints.GET /api/dashboard/portfolio/summary: 200 OK, totalProjects=10 (matches Active Projects KPI at data level)

findings: Active Projects: KPI=10 but drilldown /projects?status=active shows 0 rows (Law-9 lie). Root cause: KPI links lowercase 'active'; backend /projects ignores status (returns all 40); FE ProjectsPage filters client-side case-sensitively (ProjectsPage.tsx:186 `item.status !== filters.status`), so 'ACTIVE' !== 'active' excludes all 10. Verified lowercase link ships in deployed chunk DeliveryManagerDashboardPage-CEIX43ZM.js; dsRefresh forced ON via docker-compose.v2-staging.yml.

Active Positions: KPI=95 (DM portfolio-scoped) but drilldown /staffing-desk?status=active returns 436 rows globally (its own activeAssignments KPI=93). 95 != 436 and 95 != 93 (Law-9 lie + scope mismatch: dashboard scopes to DM portfolio, staffing-desk is org-wide).
Unstaffed: KPI=0, in-page portfolio rows with staffingCount===0 also 0 -> consistent (no mismatch to flag).
evidence: Live as carlos.vega (delivery_manager) on deliverit-test-v2.agentic.uz. GET /api/dashboard/delivery-manager -> summary={totalActiveProjects:10, totalActiveAssignments:95, projectsWithNoStaff:0}; portfolioHealth.length=10, staffingGaps.length=0, sum(staffingCount)=95, rows with staffingCount===0 = 0. Active Projects drilldown GET /api/projects?status=active -> items=40 totalCount=40 (status breakdown ACTIVE:10/CLOSED:20/COMPLETED:10 -> backend ignores status); ProjectsPage.tsx:180-186 applies case-sensitive `item.status !== filters.status` under dsRefresh, and DM chunk links lowercase 'active' -> 0 rows displayed. Active Positions drilldown GET /api/staffing-desk?status=active -> items=50 totalCount=436 kpis.activeAssignments=93 (no-status=645, invalid status=zzzz falls back to 645 -> param honored but org-wide, not DM-scoped). docker-compose.v2-staging.yml:20 confirms VITE_FORCE_FLAGS_ON=workspaceMe,dsRefresh; deployed /assets/DeliveryManagerDashboardPage-CEIX43ZM.js contains 'projects?status=active' and 'staffing-desk?status=active' (both lowercase).
